verdict.rationale: Browser Use is a browser-automation agent, so a screenshot-based vision or computer-use action mode is a fair axis for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a switchable vision mode, screenshot-driven actions, or handling of canvases the DOM path can't reach. The closest items are adjacent only: CDP/Playwright connection options, live preview for human control, and a SUPERFAST mode, none of which is a vision action mode.

support.subject: As a developer, I can switch to a vision or computer-use action mode that operates on screenshots for canvases and UIs the DOM path can't handle
